subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.*.iterationBudget`, `onBeforeToolCallingRound`, and `supportsIterationBudget` as the permanent opt-in loop-safety surface once this branch is rebased?
rationale: The implementation appears coherent and proven, but it adds public config and plugin/agent-core API surface that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept after conflict refresh
options.body: Keep the current opt-in design, resolve conflicts against main, and require normal maintainer review before merge.

options.title: Rename or narrow the surface
options.body: Ask for targeted changes to config names, defaults, or hook semantics before treating the API as public.

options.title: Defer broader loop budgeting
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep the remaining product direction in the linked iteration-budget issues.

recommendation.title: Accept after conflict refresh
recommendation.body: Keep the current opt-in design, resolve conflicts against main, and require normal maintainer review before merge.
